summary: Feed c035_crc to APM is degraded: VF-1 port 1 input is delivering damaged frames (CRC/alignment errors) above threshold, causing incomplete traffic to APM.

findings.root_cause: VF-1 port 1 (input) received 14,640 damaged frames (CRC/alignment errors, error rate 0.000314 > threshold 1e-05) indicating a faulty cable, optic, or duplex mismatch on the link into the packet broker
findings.impact_on_tool: APM will drop corrupted frames and see incomplete transactions/flows, causing gaps in application performance metrics, false retransmission/latency calculations and reduced detection coverage

recommended_fix.why: Clean L1 errors at ingress before packet broker to restore complete, error-free traffic to the APM; inspect/replace cable/optic and verify speed/duplex/autoneg on VF-1 port 1 and its peer
